duoScenes.artwork: Illustrated graphite foldable in three poses. The interior screens use native build 110 Duo simulator captures at a 100° hinge, with the app’s reserved division and active display verified. The tent poster uses the native Duo cover screenshot at 52° and the film projects the game clock demonstration onto that outer display.

ravine.direction: A broken bridge above a dark pool. Four walkers approach the cliff while one Lix bobs in the current. Illustrated woodland scenery.

detonator.direction: One cheerful blond Lix considers an oversized red plunger. Two others follow a sign towards a missing bridge. Cold spruce-blue shadows, a dusky plum sky, and a copper rim light in the mossy forest.

illustration: Project artwork generated for this site from the approved Lix icon and woodland illustration. The creek, burrow, woodland objects, four material textures and two moss-covered button sprites are illustrations. Gameplay images use the captures listed above.

clock.source: Build 110 GameDeskClockArt.drawFullScreen and DeskClockSimulation, signed Mac app resources. Simulated 14:59 to 15:00 with a fictional Tea break event. 1008 by 692, 27 seconds, 15 frames per second.
